name: Scinorx AI Readiness Check
author: Scinorx Technologies Inc

sections.description:
Your website may look good, but can search engines, AI-powered discovery systems, and potential customers clearly understand what your business does, where you operate, what services you provide, and why people should trust you?

Scinorx AI Readiness Check helps identify foundational website signals that may impact discoverability, trust, customer engagement, and modern search visibility.

Run the scan inside WordPress to get an AI readiness score and an action checklist for issues such as weak homepage content, missing business pages, incomplete metadata, limited schema signals, unclear contact paths, missing location or service-area signals, and thin trust content.

This plugin does not promise ranking results or guaranteed visibility in any AI platform. It is a practical readiness checklist for improving website clarity and structure.

Features

  • On-demand admin scan
  • AI readiness score
  • Search visibility setting
  • Crawlability and sitemap checks
  • Robots.txt accessibility checks
  • Business page and contact signal checks
  • Metadata, heading structure, and viewport checks
  • Open Graph and social metadata checks
  • Image alt text checks
  • CTA and customer engagement checks
  • Trust signal and service area checks
  • Internal linking checks
  • Structured data detection
  • Schema coverage signals
  • Optional llms.txt detection
  • User-initiated Scinorx help CTA

Designed for

  • Small business websites
  • Service-based businesses
  • Local business websites
  • Marketing and agency websites
  • WordPress site owners preparing for modern AI-assisted search experiences

Scinorx customization help

The report includes a user-initiated link to request help from Scinorx. Scinorx can help turn the checklist into real website improvements, including schema setup, service page improvements, FAQs, trust content, local business signals, and conversion-focused updates.

The plugin does not automatically send scan data to Scinorx or any third party.

Privacy

The plugin stores the latest scan report and recent scan history locally in the WordPress database.

Scinorx AI Readiness Check does not automatically send scan data to Scinorx Technologies or any third party.

Any optional support requests or contact actions are initiated directly by the user. If a site administrator chooses to share a report with Scinorx, the plugin sends the submitted name, email, website URL, optional message, score, scan summary, and key review/fix items by email using WordPress mail.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the plugin zip from WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to AI Readiness in the WordPress dashboard.
  4. Click Run AI Readiness Check.
sections.faq:
Does this guarantee AI search visibility?

No. The plugin provides a practical website readiness checklist. It does not guarantee rankings, traffic, or inclusion in any search or AI system.

Does the plugin send my scan report to Scinorx?

No. The scan runs from your WordPress admin and stores the latest report and recent scan history locally in your WordPress database. A site administrator can optionally send the report to Scinorx by submitting the share form and checking the consent box.

Does this use an external AI API?

No. Version 1.0 does not call an external AI API.

What is llms.txt?

The plugin treats llms.txt as optional and experimental. It is not required for search visibility.

Who is this for?

It is designed for small business website owners, consultants, agencies, and local service providers who want a simple readiness report.
